text:
Mira Patel: dropping a new mock for the console edit form. trying a subtle hollow dot next to labels as the required indicator instead of bold asterisks. also prototyped a small 'Required' hint that shows when the field is focused. figma: https://figma.redwood/company/console-form-v2

Priya Desai: I like the visual declutter. quick concern: in dense forms the dot might be missed by scanning users. can we show a stronger affordance on hover/focus and add an accessible name?

Jonah Rivera: +1. For analytics, we should track empty-submit rates and support mentions for required fields during the A/B. simple metric: percent of first-time users who trigger form errors within 24h after signup.

Alex Morgan: implementation note: show 'Required' under the label only on focus and when the input is empty. that keeps noise down but surfaces state to keyboard users. also, keep aria-required on the input element regardless of visual marker.

Kevin Liu: accessibility checklist: aria-required on inputs, aria-describedby linking to inline error IDs, role=alert on error text when it appears, and avoid duplicate messages (summary + inline) being read twice. for modals use role=dialog, aria-modal=true, and restore focus after close.

Mira Patel: good. proposed rule: dot by default, explicit 'Required' on focus, and aria-required="true". we can A/B versus asterisk for new org signups.

Priya Desai: on validation behavior: prefer inline errors shown on blur for single-field validation, but keep a compact consolidated summary at the top for submit-level failures that block progress (with anchor links to fields). summary should not duplicate the inline phrasing exactly.

Alex Morgan: UX nit: show inline error after blur only if the value is non-empty and invalid. if empty, wait until submit to avoid scaring users while filling long forms.

Jonah Rivera: typed-confirm debate for deletions: recommend typed-confirm for org/workspace deletes and long-lived resources. use checkbox + modal for multi-select batch deletes. always show an undo snackbar for client-side recoverable deletes (7s).

Mira Patel: copy ideas: instead of generic 'Type DELETE', ask users to 'Type the workspace name to confirm'. monospace input, helper text 'This action is permanent.' aria-live polite for helper updates.

Kevin Liu: small accessibility add: when using typed-confirm, announce the instruction via aria-live at modal open. ensure the input has an accessible label and that errors in the typed-confirm are presented as role=alert so screen reader users know why they can't proceed.

Mira Patel: action items:
- design: update focus-state to show 'Required' and hover tooltip (Priya + me)
- eng: add aria-required/aria-describedby and role=alert for errors (Kevin + Alex)
- analytics: instrument A/B metrics and empty-submit rate (Jonah)
- PM: draft typed-confirm policy and undo duration guidance (Mira)

design-bot: heads-up: add to Thu design review agenda. :spiral_calendar: 

Priya Desai: tagging this for accessibility review next week.

Mira Patel: thanks — I'll post updated frames by EOD Wednesday.
